CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_xc9386.m1_top_zips AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT pickup_zip,
         COUNT(*) AS trips,
         SUM(fare_amount) AS total_fare
  FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips
  WHERE pickup_zip IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pickup_zip
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200
),
 b_hour AS (
  SELECT pickup_zip,
         HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour
  FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips
  WHERE pickup_zip IS NOT NULL
),
 busiest AS (
  SELECT pickup_zip,
         hour AS busiest_hour
  FROM (
    SELECT pickup_zip,
           hour,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pickup_zip ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, hour ASC) AS rn
    FROM b_hour
    GROUP BY pickup_zip, hour
  ) t
  WHERE rn = 1
),
 total_rev AS (
  SELECT SUM(total_fare) AS grand_total FROM base
),
 ranked AS (
  SELECT b.pickup_zip,
         b.trips,
         ROUND(b.total_fare, 2) AS total_fare,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY b.total_fare DESC) AS fare_rank,
         ROUND(SUM(b.total_fare) OVER (ORDER BY b.total_fare DESC, b.pickup_zip ASC) / (SELECT grand_total FROM total_rev) * 100, 2) AS cumulative_share_pct
  FROM base b
),
 final AS (
  SELECT r.pickup_zip,
         r.trips,
         r.total_fare,
         r.fare_rank,
         r.cumulative_share_pct,
         bu.busiest_hour
  FROM ranked r
  JOIN busiest bu ON r.pickup_zip = bu.pickup_zip
  WHERE r.fare_rank <= 10
  ORDER BY r.fare_rank
)
SELECT * FROM final;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT pickup_zip,
         SUM(fare_amount) AS total_fare
  FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips
  WHERE pickup_zip IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pickup_zip
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200
)
SELECT SUM(total_fare) AS grand_total FROM base;
SELECT SUM(total_fare) AS top10_sum FROM workspace.exam_xc9386.m1_top_zips;

SELECT pickup_zip, total_fare,
       ROUND(SUM(total_fare) OVER (ORDER BY total_fare DESC, pickup_zip ASC) / 233763.97 * 100, 2) AS calc_cum
FROM workspace.exam_xc9386.m1_top_zips
ORDER BY fare_rank;

SELECT cumulative_share_pct, 
       ROUND(SUM(total_fare) OVER (ORDER BY total_fare DESC, pickup_zip ASC) / 233763.97 * 100, 2) AS expected_cum
FROM workspace.exam_xc9386.m1_top_zips
ORDER BY fare_rank;

WITH per_zip AS (
  SELECT pickup_zip,
         HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips
  WHERE pickup_zip IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pickup_zip, hour
), best AS (
  SELECT pickup_zip,
         MIN(hour) AS expected_hour -- MIN chooses smaller hour on tie after ordering by cnt desc then hour asc
  FROM (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pickup_zip ORDER BY cnt DESC, hour ASC) AS rn
    FROM per_zip
  ) t
  WHERE rn = 1
  GROUP BY pickup_zip
)
SELECT t.pickup_zip, t.busiest_hour, b.expected_hour
FROM workspace.exam_xc9386.m1_top_zips t
JOIN best b ON t.pickup_zip = b.pickup_zip
ORDER BY t.fare_rank;
